summary: Iteration 4 — full end-to-end frontend + spot backend validation of the new IS/NBC Engineering layer. 41/41 render + clause-library + code-search checks PASS (all 12 sub-tabs render with panels; clause chips on Storm, Parking (NBC), Fire, Accessibility and Green Rating all open the clause-dialog and return exactly one matching code-row; library search for seismic/parking/fire/rainwater/accessibility/concrete mix/foundation/wind each returns >=1 row; empty query returns full 20-row list; nonsense query shows code-library-empty). Shared-field wiring works: City=Guwahati -> Zone V and base shear 759 kN -> 2,734 kN; Soil=soft clay -> Foundation panel recommends piled raft and a [critical] warning appears citing IS 1893; Grade=M40 changes Mix Design outputs. Per-module live recompute works: grid bay X=9 changes column size, Accessibility door=600 turns 2 checks red, Fire pressurisation toggle changes eng-score-fire. Mix->BOQ table exposes Cement/Fine aggregate/Coarse/Water rows. Green Rating shows 3 auto-credited items driven by Water/Storm and toggling a manual item raises category progress and updates eng-recommendation-green from 15% -> 20%. All six engineering PDFs download as valid %PDF documents (executive, engineering, structural, water, fire, accessibility), and Structural/Water/Fire/Accessibility PDFs contain IS/NBC + Cl. references in the extracted text (verified with pypdf). Backend engineering_test.py suite (41/41) re-run and passes in 85s. Regression smoke: Plot & Site, GIS, 3D, Calculations, Engineering, Parking, Quantities, BOQ, Cost, Utilities, Compliance, Reports nav items all load without console errors. ONE CRITICAL FRONTEND BUG FOUND: shared engineering fields do NOT persist across reload — after selecting Guwahati / soft clay / M40 the save-indicator flips to 'saved' but on reload the Engineering shared section shows the defaults again (Bengaluru / Dense sand / M25). RCA confirmed: backend accepts and persists `engineering` under PUT /api/projects/{id} when sent inside `updates` (verified via direct API call), but the frontend autosave in /app/frontend/src/pages/Workspace.jsx builds its updates payload from a hard-coded EDITABLE whitelist (lines 43-46) which is missing the key 'engineering'. Because that key is never copied into `updates`, the PUT succeeds but silently drops all shared engineering config. Adding 'engineering' to the EDITABLE array fixes the reported bug #1 end-to-end.

ui_bugs.issue: Shared IS/NBC Engineering fields (city, soil_type, exposure_condition, structural_system, concrete_grade, aggregate_size_mm, cement_type, occupancy_per_unit, roof_area_sqm, green_checklist and every eng-input-* numeric) never persist. Save indicator turns 'saved' but on reload all values reset to defaults. Cause: EDITABLE whitelist in /app/frontend/src/pages/Workspace.jsx (lines 43-46) omits the 'engineering' key, so the autosave PUT body is built without it. Backend PUT /api/projects/{id} with {"updates":{"engineering":{...}}} correctly persists (confirmed via API).

action_items: In /app/frontend/src/pages/Workspace.jsx add 'engineering' to the EDITABLE array (line 43-46) so the autosave PUT includes project.engineering. One-line fix. After the fix, verify by: change city to Guwahati in IS/NBC Engineering, wait for save-indicator=saved, reload, confirm eng-city-select still shows Guwahati and eng-zone-metric still shows V.
critical_code_review_comments: Persistence whitelist duplication risk: Workspace.jsx maintains a hard-coded EDITABLE list that must be kept in sync with the backend allowed-fields set. Any new top-level project key (like `engineering`) has to be added in both places. Consider either (a) driving the whitelist from a shared constant, or (b) sending the whole project object minus server-managed keys, so a missed whitelist entry cannot cause silent data loss.

ClauseChip testid uses (library_id||code) which is good for uniqueness, but a clause with neither library_id nor code will render a testid `clause-chip-` — worth guarding, though not observed in current data.
Field.jsx NumField applies data-testid directly to the <input>, so tests should use [data-testid="eng-input-*"] not [data-testid="eng-input-*"] input.
engineering module autosave & analyse both fire on every project change; two independent 250-300 ms debounces mean up to ~1.2 s of stale UI on rapid input; acceptable, but worth calling out.

rca of the issue: Bug reproduces reliably. Steps: (1) login admin, open any project, click nav-module-engineering, wait for engineering-shared-section. (2) Change eng-city-select to Guwahati (or eng-soil-select to soft clay or eng-grade-select to M40). (3) Observe eng-zone-metric flips to V and eng-shear-metric jumps ~4x — analyse endpoint is fed the new config correctly. (4) Wait ~2s for save-indicator to read 'saved'. (5) Reload page. (6) Observe city/soil/grade have reverted to defaults. Backend evidence: `GET /api/projects/{id}` returns `engineering: {}` even after a UI-driven save; but a direct `PUT /api/projects/{id}` with body `{"updates":{"engineering":{...}}}` returns 200 and a follow-up GET shows the persisted values. Frontend evidence: Workspace.jsx:43-46 EDITABLE = ['name','client','location','plot_reference','status','plot','towers','parking','config','quantity_ratios','rates','labour_rates','equipment_rates','utility_config','compliance_rules'] — no 'engineering'. Line 85 loops over EDITABLE only, so project.engineering is never copied into `updates`. Mitigation: add 'engineering' to EDITABLE.
